graphicsDevices.device: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M5 Max, Version 26.4 (Build 25E246))

boundaries.startup: Fresh isolated browser context to engine ready. OS caches are not flushed; repeat navigation uses browser resource cache.
boundaries.cpu: Worker performance.now intervals around named work. CPU is stepMs plus renderCpuMs; cullMs and clusterMs are nested in renderCpuMs.
boundaries.cadence: summary includes every worker animation callback. submittedSummary includes accepted render submissions only; its frameMs and submissionIntervalsMs measure consecutive submissions. submittedFramesPerSecond counts submissions after the first measured callback divided by the first-to-last callback window. These are accepted submissions, not measured display presentation.
boundaries.gpu: Only renderer timestamp queries qualify. Null means not available.
boundaries.trace: Optional separate diagnostic run; excluded from timing summaries.
boundaries.motion: The worker perturbs the render camera with the same 20-second, 1-meter and 0.12-radian sway. The controller pose stays fixed while simulation still steps.
boundaries.memory: Chrome JavaScript heap estimates do not include GPU, worker Wasm, or complete browser process memory.

fixedTimeCaptures.boundary: PNG bytes from time=0 at the selected shot and pinned dimensions, captured after timing. Different hashes require decoded-pixel analysis before a parity claim.

machine.boundary: Machine information recorded when summarizing these local measurements.
